def fetch_thread_ids_by_label(label, page_limit=20):
    all_ids=set()
    for cat, api_name in categories:
        i=0
        while True:
            res = getattr(apis.gmail, api_name)(
                access_token=gmail_access_token,
                label=label,
                page_index=i,
                page_limit=page_limit
            )
            if not res:
                break
            for item in res:
                all_ids.add(item['email_thread_id'])
            i+=1
    return all_ids
